tips.t1: Just 15 minutes of German practice a day leads to fast progress.
tips.t2: Use a new German word in a sentence right after learning it — it'll stick.
tips.t3: Don't miss the daily challenge — your streak is your best teacher.
tips.t4: German pronunciation is tricky — practice speaking every day.
tips.t5: Memorize the article (der/die/das) together with every new noun.
